brief: Construct an array of yearMonthDuration from values or spread arrays
description: Construct a new array of yearMonthDuration from the given values, the same as array() except that the new array is typed: each value, and each entry of a spread array, must be dataType yearMonthDuration, and adding a value of another data type to the array later throws. A value of another data type is an error, never converted. This is usually written array<yearMonthDuration>(...values).

parameters.description: A value of dataType yearMonthDuration, or ... followed by an expression that results in an array, every entry of which is included.
parameters.name: values
